composer.auto.help: Scan a source folder and pair body motion, expressions, lips and camera by their tracks. Fill the form with a motion group, then preview it.
composer.motion.help: Required: a .vmd with bone animation. It may also contain expressions and foot IK. Camera-only or morph-only files cannot be the body motion. Nonstandard bone names need a matching reference rig.
composer.audio.help: Choose .ogg, .wav or .mp3 to adjust music synchronization. Leave empty for a motion-only preview.
composer.advanced.help: Embedded expressions, lips and camera are preserved. Use these slots to supplement or replace tracks. Repeated selections of the same file are deduplicated.
composer.face.help: Optional: extracts morph tracks without replacing body animation. Select a combined expression/lip file once. Later matching morph names replace earlier tracks. The avatar needs matching expressions.
composer.lip.help: Optional morph tracks; music does not generate lip motion. Face and lip slots both use morphs: select a combined file once. With different conflicting files, the lip file loads later.
composer.camera.help: Optional camera, light and shadow tracks, without bone/morph overrides. Leave empty if the main motion includes a camera. Enable MMD camera for playback.
composer.pmx.help: Normally leave empty to use the bundled reference rig. A custom PMX is the motion's MMD skeleton, not the playback VRM. Required joints and recognized bone names must be present.
composer.offset.help: Add a preview, then adjust synchronization. Negative starts music earlier; positive starts later. Save changes or export to keep the offset.
composer.offset.earlier.help: Reduce the audio offset to start music earlier relative to motion. Updates your active composer preview immediately and keeps it paused if paused. Export to save.
composer.offset.later.help: Increase the offset to start music later. Choose a 0.1, 0.01 or 1 second step and listen during preview.
composer.offset.saved: Draft offset: {0}s. Add & preview to listen.
composer.scale.help: Converts MMD position units; normally keep 0.08. This is not avatar size or camera zoom. Retargeting handles skeleton proportions.
composer.footIk.help: Default uses player settings. Use VMD enables solving and respects each leg's authored IK switches. Off is for baked FK motions. Saved in the package for every playback avatar.
composer.layers.help: Add supplemental VMD tracks in list order. Later matching tracks take priority; use layers for expressions, lips or partial motion.
composer.preview.help: Create a local test package, add it to the library and play it. Repeated previews create new copies. Adjust audio offset live in the active preview.
composer.export.help: Export a .vmdance containing the selected sources and audio offset. Choose a new filename to keep a separate copy.

composer.saveChanges.help: Save to the opened package and keep a backup of the original. Use Export for a separate copy.

composer.camera.reference.help: Use the current model’s eye height, preview the camera and adjust the multiplier to frame its eyes. Other models use: their eye height / reference eye height × package multiplier.
composer.camera.previewFirst: Start your package preview, adjust its camera, then capture.
